objective.text: Carry immutable event facts instead of expecting a later database reread to reproduce historical state.

difficulty.rationale: Preserve the event-time value required by a downstream historical consumer.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A queued audit listener must record the amount accepted when an order was placed. The order’s amount may later change before the listener runs. Which event payload preserves the required fact?

options.text: Carry only the order ID and always select the current amount in the listener.
options.rationale: A current-state lookup cannot recover the earlier value without a separate historical source.
options.misconception: A current-state lookup cannot recover the earlier value without a separate historical source.

options.text: Carry only an Eloquent order model using SerializesModels and read its amount later.
options.rationale: The restored model can contain the newer amount, losing the event-time fact.
options.misconception: The restored model can contain the newer amount, losing the event-time fact.

options.text: Carry the order ID and the accepted amount as explicit immutable event data.
options.rationale: The event records the historical value rather than asking a later model restoration to reconstruct it.

options.text: Use a public-channel broadcast name containing the current amount instead of event data.
options.rationale: Channel naming neither establishes a durable historical payload nor satisfies private audit storage requirements.
options.misconception: Channel naming neither establishes a durable historical payload nor satisfies private audit storage requirements.

explanation.summary: The event records the historical value rather than asking a later model restoration to reconstruct it.
